summary: Feed s106_single to IDS is degraded: VLAN 20 is completely missing and 50% of traffic is untagged, leaving the IDS blind to half the required segments.

findings.root_cause: Packet broker / SPAN is stripping 802.1Q tags or VLAN 20 is not included in the forwarding/filter map for this IDS tool port. 50% untagged packets and zero frames with VLAN 20 indicates tag stripping or incorrect VLAN trunk pruning, not normal traffic mix.
findings.impact_on_tool: IDS requires VLANs 10 and 20 for complete coverage and needs full payload with both directions. Missing VLAN 20 creates a total blind spot for that segment - intrusions, lateral movement, and C2 on VLAN 20 will not be detected and untagged packets cannot be correlated to tenant/policy.

recommended_fix.why: Restore 802.1Q preservation and add VLAN 20 to the broker forwarding map for s106_single so the IDS receives both required VLANs tagged correctly.
